prompt: And what about our 40-person Saudi SME supplier? What do the NCA controls require of them?
assertions: Places the supplier in Category B (6 to 249 employees or SAR 3M to 200M revenue) under NCNICC-1:2025
States Category B faces 13 sub-components and 26 mandatory controls, with the remainder recommended
Notes the instrument was published in Arabic only
States compliance is continuous with no published deadline
Distinguishes NCNICC applicability from the ECC, which targets critical national infrastructure
